meta.name: School of Lies
meta.description: A young 12-year-old boy, who goes missing from a private boarding school, RISE, and how the subsequent domino effect it causes as the truth is only as complex as simple.

videos.title: "Absent, Sir"
videos.overview: Search begins for the missing 12-year-old Shakti on the school premises, making his mother tense. While his bunk-mate Murli appears wary, seniors Vikram and TK try to hide a secret.

videos.title: Raided
videos.overview: Investigating Officer Rawat uncovers an important clue. Bhola threatens Vikram. As Nandita starts her inquiry with Murli, Shakti and Chanchal explore their friendship.

videos.title: The Babysitter
videos.overview: Trisha goes to the media. Officers Rawat and Prakash encounter danger. Vikram and TK are at loggerheads. While Nandita meets Dev, Vikram's mother, Pallavi, visits him.

videos.title: Sir River's Ghost
videos.overview: Alden, Sam Sir's brother comes to Dalton Town to protect him and Vikram and TK face a grave threat. While Trisha and Anirudh are questioned, a horrid realisation dawns upon Bhola.

videos.title: God's Test
videos.overview: Trisha and Anirudh are frantic to find their son. Vikram and TK's friendship gets tested. Estranged from Pritika, Vikram finds a pal in Nandita. Sam Sir reveals a shocking secret.

videos.title: Dapostar Boy
videos.overview: Murli and Shakti have a fallout. A desperate Bhola looks for his son, Chanchal while Pallavi fears for Vikram. Shakti plans his escape, unaware of his fate.

videos.title: Hen Coop
videos.overview: Vikram and TK get into trouble with Bhola. The cops tighten their reins. While Sam Sir is accused of the unthinkable, Nandita's pursuit leads her towards the shocking truth.

videos.title: The Choice
videos.overview: Sam Sir accepts his fate. Nandita's turmoil worsens while Pallavi feels devastated. Vikram and TK's friendship faces its conclusive test. Finally, the secret gets revealed.
